{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Marionette''' is a tanky enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a decent amount of health and decent speed, both worse than the [[Citizen Plush]]. However, it makes up for that with its defense, which is set to 100%. ==Appearance== The '''Marionette''' is a puppet made out of wood. It has lower arms and legs in its rig. It has a carved head, resembling a mannequin. It is connected to a wooden crossbeam by a few strings. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Accelerator]] are sufficient to deal with the '''Marionette'''. **Multiple early-game oriented towers, like the [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] can also do quite well. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be quite useful at boosting the firerate and range of your towers. *The '''Marionette''' has a rather high defense, making it harder to take down. **Towers which bypass defense, such as the [[Mortar]], [[Mercenary Base]] with splash and collisions or the [[Rocketeer]] can be useful here. **Defense dropping towers can be used to drop its high defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} MarionetteWalk.gif|Walking animation (22 January 2025 - Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Marionette.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMarionette.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Game Master Ultimate Skin - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Marionette''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MarionetteIndex.png|'''Marionette''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Marionette''' added. *'''29 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0]] **Cash given increased from {{Money|250}} to {{Money|325}} on death. **[[Stun Immunity]] removed. {{PizzaParty|[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]]|Wave 15|Marionette|Wave 16|[[Clown]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
